claims.text: The published path branches on whether the new address remains in the same distributor's operating area; if not, the manual describes a same-town transfer using old- and new-distributor voucher steps.
claims.notes: No current Bengaluru service-area check was made.

claims.text: For the same distributor area, Bharatgas says to advise the distributor of the new address with supporting residence proof, after which the distributor changes records for future supplies.
claims.notes: Address proof variant and processing result are unobserved.

claims.text: For same-town service-area change, the manual says old distributor uses the original Subscription Voucher to prepare TTV/CTA Out; the customer then presents residence proof, TTV/CTA Out and DGCC booklet to the receiving distributor, which prepares TSV/CTA In and provides a new consumer number.
claims.notes: Published 2021 sequence, not a live transaction.

claims.text: The blank official form asks for transferor/transferee, SV and consumer number, transfer type and declarations; it includes a distributor physical-verification block.
claims.notes: The form was read only; no personal information or signature was supplied.

claims.text: No public workflow review establishes the current OMC/distributor for a Bengaluru address, current fee/security deposit, inter-town route, accepted proof variants, or approval/timing for a real connection.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, lookup, upload, payment or submission.
